bidirectional.forward: sequence/regulatory -> expression -> growth -> EI -> deflection margin. Only the last arrow has a computed model here; every earlier arrow is a proposed, uncalibrated interface.

forward_hypothesis_discrimination.assumed_noise: independent ln-reading SD 0.2 per section (ASSUMED, the R1 scale)
hypotheses: H-tip: same total force at the tip
forward_hypothesis_discrimination.outputs: separation d' = |difference of mean statistic| / SD, and replicates for d' >= 2 (needs independent specimens; repeats on one specimen share discrepancy)
forward_hypothesis_discrimination.statistic: ln[w(x=L)/w(x=0.5L)] read from saved FEM profiles (parameter-free: EI and q cancel)

bidirectional.inverse: target observable -> candidate set. Executed only for the mechanical layer: the screen ranks a finite (length, EI multiplier) grid against the target 'both load shapes inside the linear envelope'. Inversion to sequence is NOT attempted: no calibrated map exists, so no full-genome or regulatory-element inversion is claimed.

candidates.note: Full 6 x 5 grid; the three recorded assurance candidates (0.15/1, 0.12/1, 0.15/2) are positive controls inside it.

controls: C1: analytic screen reproduces the recorded pass flag on all 192 recorded (candidate, draw) trials (expect 0 mismatches)
C2: zero-load candidate (q=0) passes every draw; infinite-load (q x 1e6) passes none
C3: mutant law (tip = qL^2/EI, wrong exponent) must change at least one recorded flag, else C1 cannot detect that fault
C4: a readout with zero sensitivity to the target gives zero variance reduction
finalist_rule: Highest FEM pass fraction among survivors; ties go to the smaller EI multiplier, then the longer ray. A declared tie-break, not a biological winner.

inputs.latent_laws: assumed, from the assurance protocol; not fitted to any fin

instruments.calibration_context: none needed: reads a saved simulated field; context = the saved draw's assumed latents
instruments.forward_noise_model: y = w_saved(x)/L, deterministic; no noise sampled
instruments.observable: w(x)/L at fixed sections of a saved FEM profile
instruments.reference_control: closed-form analytic deflection of the same inputs; coarse/fine FEM difference stored with each case
instruments.sampling_cross_section: x/L in {0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0}; one beam, one load shape per saved case
instruments.uncertainty: numerical discretisation only (stored grid difference); no biological uncertainty

instruments.observable: tip/L and max slope of a saved case
instruments.reference_control: the assurance predicate's analytic residual field
instruments.sampling_cross_section: tip station and max over saved stations

instruments.acceptance: reference beam EI recovered within 2 SD of the declared noise
instruments.blocked_on: no specimen, clamp or load-cell data
instruments.calibration_context: needs clamp compliance and load-cell calibration; ex vivo
instruments.forward_noise_model: ln y = -ln EI + 3 ln L + e, e~N(0, 0.04) ASSUMED
instruments.reference_control: known-stiffness reference beam in the same clamp
instruments.sampling_cross_section: clamp-to-tip, one load level per read
instruments.uncertainty: assumed noise only; no fish data

instruments.calibration_context: needs flow-speed and imaging scale calibration; in vivo
instruments.forward_noise_model: ln y = lnq + 3 ln L - ln EI + e + d, e~N(0,0.04), d~N(0,0.09) shared by repeats on one fish; ASSUMED
instruments.reference_control: rigid-plate control in the same flow (expect zero deflection)

instruments.forward_noise_model: ln y = ln q + e, e~N(0,0.09) ASSUMED
ln y = ln L + e, e~N(0,0.0025) ASSUMED

instruments.blocked_on: native mechanobio sequence-evidence ledger; no expression calibration
instruments.calibration_context: needs matched cell state and reporter calibration
instruments.forward_noise_model: undefined: no calibrated mapping from sequence to expression

interfaces: See interface-map.json: sequence/regulatory and cell/growth tests are PROPOSALS blocked on calibration; only the material/fin row has a numerical execution here.

measurement.baseline: equal-budget naive plan: all budget on in-flow tip deflection replicates (R2 x2), the most direct-looking readout
measurement.decision: Whether the finalist stays inside the declared linear regime (margin > 0) at the target load: keep the linear model, or stop and use a nonlinear/larger-deformation model.
measurement.expected_misclassification: Monte Carlo over the Gaussian prior and the linear likelihood: probability that the sign of the posterior-mean margin disagrees with the true margin sign; seed 20261101, 20000 draws
measurement.objective: expected reduction of target posterior variance, divided by cost; ties by information nats
measurement.prior: sample covariance of ln EI, ln q, ln L over the 64 recorded draws (an assumed latent law, not biological variability)

readouts.context: ex vivo, clamping may differ from in vivo
readouts.definition: excised-ray clamped bending compliance under a KNOWN applied load; ln(delta/F) offset removed
readouts.unit_replicate: one ray from one fish (biological replicate = fish)

readouts.context: in vivo/in flow; the shared term is an ASSUMED load-shape and 3D model discrepancy common to repeats on one specimen
readouts.definition: tip deflection / L of the ray in flow at the target speed
readouts.unit_replicate: one fish; repeated flows on one fish are technical repeats

readouts.definition: independent distributed-load estimate (pressure or force) at the ray

sensitivity_grid.note: every combination of per-readout scales (3^8 = 6561); report how often each plan ranks first

measurement.target: ln_margin = ln(0.3) - (ln_q + 3 ln_L - ln_EI), the finalist's log distance to the linear-validity limit; deviations from the draw-sample mean (prior mean 0)

pass_predicate: Both uniform and same-total tip load: tip/L <= 0.1 and max slope <= 0.2 rad (assurance predicate)
question: Which cheap screens remove which ray candidates, and which single measurement plan most reduces uncertainty in the finalist's linear-validity margin per declared cost?
refine: Survivors of S1-S4 are re-run through the 8- and 32-element FEM for both load shapes on all 64 draws. Analytic/FEM agreement is numerical consistency, not empirical validation. Disagreements are retained.

screens.basis: ASSUMED lift-area proxy; flight consequence of shortening is unmodeled
ASSUMED fabrication/mass cap; stiffness cost is unknown
Closed form q L^3/EI <= 0.3 (point-load tip is the binding case); exact agreement with recorded flags is checked as a control
screens.rule: reject if analytic pass fraction over the 64 draws < 0.5
reject if another S1-S3 survivor has pass fraction >= and length >= and EI_multiplier <=, with one strict

stop_criteria: Stop if any control fails (the run refuses to select).
A physical measurement plan needs executing-lab constraints, replicates per fish, and exact context refs; none are supplied here.
Stop acquiring when posterior SD of the margin falls below 0.1 (assumed) or the budget is spent.
title: Finite fin-ray candidate screen and next-measurement selection

virtual_validation.acceptance: max |w_saved - w_analytic| / L <= 1e-4 at every section, every draw
controls: V-C1: a unit-mislabelled instrument (reads w in m but is compared as w/L) must fail acceptance
V-C2: a section off the saved grid is refused rather than interpolated silently
virtual_validation.forward_model: the virtual instrument reads the saved field at the section; it applies NO sampled noise and creates no response rows. The noise model is declared for planning only.
virtual_validation.reference: closed-form Euler-Bernoulli deflection of the same inputs (beam.w_uniform / beam.w_point_load)
virtual_validation.source: saved FEM w/L profiles in all-simulations.json (81 stations) for the three recorded candidates, both load shapes, all 64 draws
virtual_validation.status: simulation_derived: agreement of two numerical solutions, not empirical validation
